purpose: General-purpose role algebra for theorem-workstation GNNs. Substrates instantiate this library with local vocabulary and obligation graphs; the ranker consumes typed obligations, not domain-specific endpoint names.

carrier.definition: The ambient mathematical object that must stay fixed or be transported explicitly.

index_or_scale.definition: The parameter controlling localization, truncation, filtration, degree, frequency, or iteration.

incidence.definition: The relation saying two objects live in the same tree, diagram, sigma-algebra, support, or parent-child structure.
ns_instance: bad node to Duhamel event incidence

budget.definition: A finite resource that is consumed, dropped, charged, or preserved.

lock.definition: A same-carrier or same-context constraint preventing a proof object from silently moving to a different space.

freshness.definition: A condition that a resource/event/object is new rather than inherited or reused.

adapter.definition: A transport, coercion, restriction, projection, lifting, or constructor that repairs one obligation without asserting the endpoint.

guard.definition: A negative theorem, obstruction, endpoint echo, circular lemma, or non-applicability condition used as context rather than as a repair.

navier_stokes_same_tree.budget: beta-square radius and Duhamel/enstrophy event budget
navier_stokes_same_tree.freshness: fresh frequency packet, not inherited badness
navier_stokes_same_tree.adapter: bounded fanout, pressure lock, prefix domination constructors
navier_stokes_same_tree.guard: endpoint Carleson echo, event-per-node tautology, classical r^2 charge

probability_filtration.incidence: event membership in sigma algebra and adaptedness
probability_filtration.freshness: new stopping event or unspent tail split
probability_filtration.guard: wrong filtration, post-hoc stopping rule, union-bound double count

harmonic_analysis_tiles.index_or_scale: dyadic scale, tile, or Littlewood-Paley index
harmonic_analysis_tiles.incidence: support overlap, tree, or tile relation
harmonic_analysis_tiles.guard: endpoint interpolation echo or reused overlap budget

category_diagram.carrier: object, structure, universe, module, or group
category_diagram.index_or_scale: degree, filtration, grading, or diagram level
category_diagram.incidence: diagram edge, chain boundary, or naturality square
category_diagram.budget: rank, finite generation, exactness, or dimension condition
category_diagram.lock: same object under equivalence or same morphism domain-codomain
category_diagram.freshness: new factorization or unspent universal property
category_diagram.guard: wrong object, wrong universe, circular equivalence

optimization_projection.carrier: feasible set, vector space, topology, or constraint family
optimization_projection.budget: descent amount, Lipschitz reserve, error tolerance
optimization_projection.lock: same norm, same inner product, same constraint set
optimization_projection.freshness: new descent step or unspent slack
optimization_projection.adapter: projection lemma, duality lemma, subgradient transport
optimization_projection.guard: wrong norm, inactive constraint, reused descent
